seed: A window captured by clicking it used to keep macOS's own shadow baked into the picture, far too dark on the canvas and pasted elsewhere (the user, 2026-10-13). It now comes in as the bare window on one layer wearing a lighter copy of macOS's shadow as a layer style. This walk opens a real click capture of a dark, active window (made by the probe's --window-shot-diag), picks the window, and holds its shadow to being there, editable and switchable in the panel, with no flag changed from Next's defaults.

steps.note: THE TEST: the capture opens as one Window layer, picked, with its shadow as Shadow 1 in Effects and the hairline as Shadow 2
the window's shadow switched off in the panel: the canvas keeps only the hairline at the window's edge
